prompt: My history professor can (speak / talk) Ancient Greek as easily as he reads Latin.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков (Ancient Greek) используется глагол speak.

prompt: Excuse me, does anyone at the airport information desk (speak / talk) Mandarin or Korean?
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранными языками (Mandarin, Korean) употребляется speak.

prompt: After spending five years in Seoul, David now (speak / talk) Korean almost without an accent.
explanation_ru: Для указания на знание языка (Korean) используется глагол speak в форме 3-го лица единственного числа.

prompt: Any economist claiming that housing prices will drop by half tomorrow is clearly (speak / talk) through their hat.
explanation_ru: Устойчивая идиома talk through one's hat (нести чушь, говорить о том, в чём не разбираешься) требует глагола talk.

prompt: Ignore Mark when he is tired — he has no idea what the issue is and is just (speak / talk) nonsense.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении talk nonsense (нести чушь, говорить ерунду) используется глагол talk.

prompt: Can we please ask the doctors not to (speak / talk) shop all evening during my sister's wedding dinner?
explanation_ru: Фразеологизм talk shop (говорить о работе в нерабочей обстановке) употребляется только с глаголом talk.

prompt: The emergency nurse noted that the patient was dizzy and struggled to (speak / talk) clearly.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о физической способности произносить слова или манере речи, предпочтителен глагол speak.

prompt: Could you please (speak / talk) a bit more slowly? I am still learning Portuguese and miss half the words.
explanation_ru: С наречиями, описывающими скорость и манеру речи (more slowly), используется глагол speak.

prompt: The hiker was so exhausted after the rescue that she could barely (speak / talk) for ten minutes.
explanation_ru: Для описания физической способности издавать звуки и произносить слова (could barely speak) используется speak.

prompt: Having (speak / talk) at four consecutive medical conferences this month, Dr. Lin needed a week of rest.
explanation_ru: Для официальных выступлений с докладом или речью на конференции (speak at a conference) используется глагол speak.

prompt: Every time my grandparents visit on holidays, they (speak / talk) politics until midnight.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании talk politics (обсуждать политику) используется глагол talk без предлога.

prompt: When I dialed the extension, a calm voice answered, “Good afternoon, Helen Vance (speak / talk).”
explanation_ru: В телефонном этикете для представления себя используется устойчивая форма speaking (у аппарата / слушаю).

prompt: Candidates for the diplomatic mission in Cairo must (speak / talk) fluent Arabic. During the interview, the panel will also ask them to (speak / talk) briefly about regional trade. Afterward, everyone can relax and (speak / talk) informally over coffee.
explanation_ru: С названием языка (Arabic) используется только speak; для официального выступления — speak (допустимо talk), а для непринуждённой беседы — talk.

prompt: How many foreign languages does your new roommate from Belgium (speak / talk)? Yesterday we (speak / talk) for an hour about his hometown in Brussels. He even promised not to (speak / talk) too fast when we practice French together.
explanation_ru: Со словом languages используется speak; для дружеской беседы в прошлом — talked, а для темпа речи (too fast) — speak.

prompt: To calibrate the new smart speaker, you need to (speak / talk) clearly into the top microphone. The device can understand users who (speak / talk) English, German, or Dutch. Please do not (speak / talk) nonsense during the voice setup, or the profile will fail.
explanation_ru: Для чёткого произнесения (speak clearly) и владения языками (speak English) используется speak, а в выражении talk nonsense — talk.

prompt: During the charity concert intermission, two critics stood near the lobby (speak / talk) politics instead of discussing the symphony. One of them could barely (speak / talk) above the crowd noise. When the bell rang, the host stepped on stage to (speak / talk) to the audience.
explanation_ru: В выражении talk politics используется talk; для громкости голоса (speak above the noise) и обращения со сцены — speak.

prompt: At Friday's barbecue, the software developers agreed not to (speak / talk) shop while grilling burgers. However, within twenty minutes they were (speak / talk) about server bugs again. Finally, the host asked them to (speak / talk) sense and enjoy their food.
explanation_ru: Устойчивые идиомы talk shop (говорить о работе) и talk sense (говорить разумные вещи) требуют глагола talk.

prompt: Welcome to the quiet reading room. Please stop (speak / talk) once you pass the main doors. If you must (speak / talk) to a librarian, keep your voice low.
explanation_ru: Для запрета на болтовню в тихом месте используется stop talking, а для вежливого обращения к сотруднику — speak to.

prompt: Because of a severe throat infection, the actor could hardly (speak / talk) during rehearsal. The doctor advised him not to (speak / talk) at all for two days. Instead, he used a notepad to (speak / talk) with the director.
explanation_ru: Физическая способность подавать голос (could hardly speak) передаётся глаголом speak, а общение с собеседником — talk with.

prompt: When Elena saw that the last train had just left the platform, she was too shocked to ___.
explanation_ru: В значении «произнести хоть слово / физически заговорить» от сильных эмоций (too shocked to speak) используется глагол speak.

prompt: None of the tourists on our bus ___ Hungarian, so we relied on hand gestures at the market.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения языком (Hungarian) используется только глагол speak (в прошедшем времени — spoke).

prompt: After weeks of tension, the two union leaders finally agreed to hold direct ___ in Vienna.
explanation_ru: Официальные переговоры между сторонами называются существительным во множественном числе — talks (peace talks, direct talks).

prompt: Thank goodness someone at the parent meeting is finally ___ sense about the bus schedule!
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении talk sense (говорить дельные, разумные вещи) используется глагол talk.

prompt: Has the guest biologist already talked at the morning panel, or is his presentation after lunch?
answer: Has the guest biologist already spoken at the morning panel, or is his presentation after lunch?
accepted_answers: Has the guest biologist already spoken at the morning panel, or is his presentation after lunch?
explanation_ru: Для официального выступления с докладом перед аудиторией (at the panel) используется глагол speak (spoken), а не talk.

prompt: Raised in a bilingual family in Montreal, Sofia learned to talk French and English from an early age.
answer: Raised in a bilingual family in Montreal, Sofia learned to speak French and English from an early age.
accepted_answers: Raised in a bilingual family in Montreal, Sofia learned to speak French and English from an early age.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков (French and English) используется глагол speak, а не talk.

prompt: All three of my nieces in Zurich speak German and Italian fluently.
answer: All three of my nieces in Zurich speak German and Italian fluently.
accepted_answers: All three of my nieces in Zurich speak German and Italian fluently.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: с названиями языков (German and Italian) используется глагол speak.

prompt: After vocal cord surgery, singers are advised not to talk above a whisper for ten days.
answer: After vocal cord surgery, singers are advised not to speak above a whisper for ten days.
accepted_answers: After vocal cord surgery, singers are advised not to speak above a whisper for ten days.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о физической работе голосовых связок и громкости голоса (above a whisper), используется глагол speak.

prompt: Your project team is wasting time on unrealistic ideas, and only the lead designer proposes a practical plan.
options: We should follow the lead designer — she is the only one talking sense.
We should follow the lead designer — she is the only one speaking sense.
We should follow the lead designer — she is the only one saying sense.
We should follow the lead designer — she is the only one telling sense.
explanation_ru: Правильная идиома со значением «говорить разумные вещи» — talk sense.

prompt: You answer an incoming phone call at the clinic reception and want to ask the caller's name politely.
options: Hello, Green Valley Clinic — who is speaking, please?
Hello, Green Valley Clinic — who is talking, please?
Hello, Green Valley Clinic — who is saying, please?
Hello, Green Valley Clinic — who is telling, please?
explanation_ru: Стандартная вежливая формула в телефонном разговоре для уточнения собеседника — Who is speaking, please?

prompt: Rewrite using the noun 'talks': Both ministries have sent representatives to Brussels to negotiate a new trade agreement.
answer: Both ministries have sent representatives to Brussels for trade talks.
accepted_answers: Both ministries have sent representatives to Brussels for trade talks.
Both ministries have sent representatives to Brussels for a new round of trade talks.
explanation_ru: Официальные переговоры (negotiate a trade agreement) в английском языке передаются существительным talks (trade talks).
